body:
Looking for ways to use your new Toddler Tower? We’ve got you covered!

The dadada Baby Toddler Tower is built with the same high-quality construction as our cribs and dressers, with easy-to-adjust steps to reach a variety of heights, baby-safe finishes, and a variety of playful, adorable colors.

Here are a few of our favorite ways the Toddler Tower can help with your child's next exploratory phase!

Master Chef in the Making

Whether you’re baking cookies, making breakfast, or packing school lunches, toddlers LOVE a chance to help in the kitchen! Some of our favorite kid-chef activities include:

  • Making cookie dough balls and placing them on baking sheets
  • Scrambling eggs with a whisk
  • Pulling stems off of mushrooms, green beans, or strawberries
  • Kneading dough or making playdough
  • Decorating cakes or cookies
  • Sorting, well, just about anything!

Tool Bench Assistant

With all power and sharp tools touch safely out of reach, the Toddler Tower is a great way to explore building in the workshop! Try letting your toddler:

  • Sand with a sheet of sandpaper
  • Use a lightweight hammer to hammer nails (be sure to supervise carefully and protect tiny fingers)
  • Paint a birdhouse or little library
  • Glue pieces of wood together
  • Build with popsicle sticks

Cleaning Helper

Those cleaning tasks that feel tedious to grown-ups can be big, splash fun for little ones! Let your toddler help around the house by:

  • Washing plastic dishes and cups in the kitchen sink
  • Washing windows with a sponge
  • Using a feather duster to dust a secured bookshelf
  • Hang up clothes in their closet

Fidgety Diner Solution

If you have a toddler who struggles to sit still in a chair, try pulling the Toddler Tower up to a kitchen island and letting them stand at mealtime. They can dance and wiggle safely while eating, and you’ll spend more time enjoying your meal and less time saying “Sit down please” over and over.

Bathroom Boss

Autonomy is a BIG deal to newly self-defined “big kids.” Help yours feel independent by pulling the Toddler Tower up to the bathroom sink so they can:

  • Brush their teeth
  • Comb their hair
  • Wash their hands
  • Play with makeup or face paint
  • Play with bath toys in the sink
What’s your favorite way to use your dadada Baby Toddler Tower? Share you photos and ideas with us on social media by using #dadadaToddlerTower - we might even share your family photos on our page!
